dog.hollowgrin.refuse: The dog will not come near you.
game.hollowgrin.help.title: Mr. Hollowgrin's Games - "Shall we play, new friend?" (click a line to start)
game.hollowgrin.help.redlight: /hollowgames redlight - Red Light, Green Light: run on green, freeze on red
game.hollowgrin.help.musicbox: /hollowgames musicbox - Music Box: remember the melody, press hotbar keys 1-9
game.hollowgrin.help.dodge: /hollowgames dodge - Snowball Dodge: survive 45 seconds with 3 lives
game.hollowgrin.help.stop: /hollowgames stop - quit the game you are playing
game.hollowgrin.common.busy: You are already playing. Use /hollowgames stop to quit.
game.hollowgrin.common.cant: You can't start a game right now (get off your ride, wake up, be alive...).
game.hollowgrin.common.stopped: You left the game. He waits patiently.
game.hollowgrin.common.nogame: You are not playing any game.
game.hollowgrin.common.reward_wait: He does not pay twice so soon. Try again in %s seconds for a prize.
game.hollowgrin.rl.name: Red Light, Green Light
game.hollowgrin.rl.intro: Run %s blocks in total. Freeze when he says RED!
game.hollowgrin.rl.timeout.sub: He laughs. The game is over.
game.hollowgrin.mb.name: Music Box

game.hollowgrin.dg.name: Snowball Dodge
